# sample_path { #mofography.compute.sample_path }

`compute.sample_path(path_indices, points_per_path=100)`

It takes a list of points and returns a list of points that are evenly spaced along the path defined
by the input points using spline interpolation

## Parameters

| Name              | Type   | Description                                                               | Default    |
|-------------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `path_indices`    |        | a numpy array of shape (n,3) where n is the number of points in the path  | _required_ |
| `points_per_path` |        | The number of points to sample along the path, defaults to 100 (optional) | `100`      |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                                             |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | a list of points that are evenly spaced along the path. |
